extensionDescription.message: Arc-like tweaks for Zen: the sidebar over fullscreen video, only this space's tabs in the address bar, Cmd+T like in Arc, Ctrl+J and Ctrl+K in the address bar, Ctrl+Tab through recent tabs, a window on Cmd+Tab, PiP buttons on the right, Picture-in-Picture like in Arc, Little Arc, Glance like Peek.

fullscreenSidebarDescription.message: In compact mode, the sidebar slides out when you move the pointer to the left edge of a fullscreen video.

workspaceTabsTitle.message: Only this space's tabs in the address bar

workspaceTabsDescription.message: “Switch to tab” no longer offers tabs from other spaces, so Enter opens the address in the current space instead of jumping away.

arcNewTabDescription.message: In the bar Cmd+T opens, an open tab of this space that matches what you typed comes first, so Enter switches to it instead of searching. The bar opens empty, and new tabs go to the top of the list; a hidden New Tab button stays hidden. Turns off “Only this space's tabs in the address bar”. If you change these settings in Zen yourself, the tweak switches off.

urlbarKeysTitle.message: Ctrl+J and Ctrl+K in the address bar

urlbarKeysDescription.message: Ctrl+J and Ctrl+K move through the suggestions in the bar Cmd+T or Cmd+L opens, like the arrow keys and Ctrl+N and Ctrl+P. Switches off if you assign Ctrl+J or Ctrl+K to something in Zen's keyboard shortcuts.

recentCtrlTabDescription.message: Ctrl+Tab switches to the tab of this space you used last, not to the next one in the list; keep holding Ctrl and press Tab again to go further back. If you turn off “Ctrl+Tab cycles through tabs in recently used order” in Zen's settings, the tweak switches off.

reopenOnActivateDescription.message: When Zen has no windows left, switching to it opens a new one, just like clicking its Dock icon.

pipButtonsTitle.message: Close and minimize on the right in Picture-in-Picture

pipButtonsDescription.message: Close and minimize move to the right corner of the Picture-in-Picture window, and “Back to tab” moves to the left, as on Windows.

arcPipDescription.message: “Back to tab” in the top left, the site's domain in the middle, Minimize and Close in the top right; play/pause and 15-second seeking in the center; a thin progress bar at the bottom. Labels and the domain show up when they fit. A playing video moves to Picture-in-Picture by itself when you switch away from its tab. Turns off “Close and minimize on the right”.

littleArcTitle.message: Little Arc for links from other apps

littleArcDescription.message: A link from another app opens in a small window with the current space's theme and container, unless a Space Routing rule sends it to its own space; the default route for external links is not used. Cmd+O moves it to the current space, Cmd+Shift+O picks a space, Esc closes it, and Cmd+Opt+N opens an empty one to search from.

arcGlanceDescription.message: The Close, Expand and Split buttons next to a Glance become large white circles, as in Arc's Peek.

loadError.message: Zen Tweaks can't reach the browser. Set extensions.experiments.enabled to true in about:config and restart Zen.
